subject: Proposal: Consolidated Annual Reserve + Performance Credits for LumenHealth
messages:
From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@lumenhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: LumenHealth Procurement <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Exploring annual prepay options and multi-year discounts

Hi Kimberly,

Were interested in moving LumenHealth from monthly billing to an annual prepay model for our core inference usage. Before we loop in procurement and legal, could you outline:

- Typical discount tiers for 12- and 24-month prepay terms (we're currently on a month-to-month plan).
- How you handle ramp months where our usage spikes early after launch (were expecting a 3x initial spike in Q1 next year).
- Any safety nets or true-up mechanics you offer in the first 90 days.

Numbers would be helpful so procurement can greenlight a PO; also send a sample contract/term sheet. Wed like to avoid hard annual true-ups that will penalize us during the initial growth window.

Thanks,
Alex Reed
Director, Platform
LumenHealth
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: LumenHealth Procurement <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Exploring annual prepay options and multi-year discounts

Alex Thanks for the clear ask. Below is a pragmatic offer designed to protect LumenHealth during your early growth phase while giving you predictable unit economics.

High-level options (summary):
- Option A: 12-month annual prepay: 8% effective discount off list rates; quarterly true-up (caps below).
- Option B: 24-month annual prepay: 15% effective discount; built-in 6-month soft ramp (see details).

Ramp & safety-net (what we recommend):
- Soft ramp: first 3 months are measured against a conservative baseline (you pay actual usage up to 2.5x baseline, beyond that we apply a 50% credit back to the next invoice as a safety net).
- Quarterly true-up: usage over the prepay reserve is credited against the subsequent quarter; annual reconciliation only after month 12 (no retroactive clawbacks in year 1).
- Spike protection: for the initial 90 days we will apply a temporary buffer (one-time credit pool equal to 5% of the prepay amount) to absorb unexpected bursts.

Concessions we can consider (subject to approvals):
- Faster ramp protection for product launches (extend soft ramp to 6 months).
- Minimum commitment add-on to lock in deeper discounts.

Next steps:
1) Confirm whether you prefer 12- or 24-month term.
2) Share procurement contact + preferred purchase vehicle.
3) Ill circulate a tailored term sheet and DocuSign-ready contract.

See attached for a starter pricing grid and proposed ramp schedule.
[Attachment: Lumen_Offer_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: ramp_schedule_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through trade-offs.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Exploring annual prepay options and multi-year discounts

Folks looping you in for sign-off. LumenHealth wants protection for an early spike; proposed public offer below (from my reply).

Question: can we agree to the soft ramp extension to 6 months for this account and bump the 12-month discount to 8% (from standard 5%) as a one-time sales concession? Their projected ARR at commit is meaningful but theyre price-sensitive.

Also flagging a legal ask: they want no retroactive clawbacks in year 1. Well need procurement to accept quarterly true-ups only with annual reconciliation at renew.

Im happy to take technical calls re: SLA expectations.

- Kimberly
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: FW: Exploring annual prepay options and multi-year discounts

Kimberly / team,

Agree to support the account with these guardrails. My proposed negotiated terms (approved by me for commercial concessions up to 10%):

- Final commercial offer:
  - 12-month prepaid reserve: 10% discount off list if they sign within 30 days.
  - 24-month prepaid reserve: 18% discount off list + flat monthly price cap for first six months.

- Ramp & reconciliation:
  - Soft ramp for months 0-6 (baseline multiplier 2.5x; any incremental above that triggers a 50% credit applied to next invoice).
  - No retroactive clawbacks in year 1; true-up rolled quarterly and annual reconciliation only affects renewal credits.

- SLA concession: include a 99.9% best-effort latency SLO for production endpoints; for sustained misses we provide service credits (kept conservative).

Ive attached the updated offer & ramp schedule and prepared a DocuSign envelope for signatures. If legal wants to tighten language around credits, route to me first.
[Attachment: Lumen_Offer_v2.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: ramp_schedule_v3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Marissa Cole
